posts.content_md:
This is one of the best things we can talk about. Dr Joeng has some simple online instructions here:

[http://www.holokits.com/a-make_holograms.htm](http://www.holokits.com/a-make_holograms.htm)

I would like to make a Holography FAQ but I would need lots of help. Dinesh can you write some short answers to theory questions? I wil write the questions and email them to you?

I can answer some fo the simple questions like what is a volume hologram. I also think we need a glossery. What words would we like to see?
